### `GET /api/v4/lists/{projectId}/people` — Fetches all people in a list.
operationId: `v4.v4.lists.people.index`

**Params:**

- `fields[]` (query, `api.person.field`[]) — Fields can be included by passing them into the `fields` query parameter. Be careful as this will slow down requests.
- `exclude[]` (query, `api.person.field`[]) — Fields can be excluded by passing them into the `exclude` query parameter.
- `counts[]` (query, `api.person.countableFields`[]) — The count of any countable field can be included in the `counts` field by added the required fields to the `count` query parameter.
- `sortBy` (query, string ∈ {"id", "name", "createdAt", "updatedAt"}) — The field that should be used to sort the results. The direction can be specified with the `sortOrder` parameter.
- `status` (query, integer[]) — Filter people with a specified status in the context of the list. If more than one status is specified then results matching any of the status will be returned.

**Shared params** (see `conventions.md`): `query`, `filterOn[]`, `page`, `from`, `to`, `count`, `sortOrder`, `since`, `before`, `between`, `view`, `withArchived`, `archived`, `fuzzy`, `tags[]`, `isCandidate`, `onCompanies`
